      "note": "Describes how uplink interference can disturb the base‑station receiver and cause increased error rates; however it is an LTE‑specific (NR‑unspecific) informative annex."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "A.18 Monitor of BLER performance",
